scientific_integrity: The full-support classification has a separate case-by-case proof; remaining full weight counts use two exact exhaustive algorithms over 59049 distinct coefficient vectors. No extrapolation beyond the finite domain.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the ternary (q,s,d)=(3,5,2) toric hypersimplex code only; the signed-graph symmetry is not claimed to be the entire code automorphism group. An unindexed prior weight table or equivalent model cannot be excluded.
title: Complete weight spectrum and zero-free signed-graph classes of the ternary \(\Delta_{5,2}\) code
